content.title: When 'Daredevil: Born Again' Releases on Disney+ & Full Schedule
content.text: Published Mar 24, 2026, 1:00 PM EDT Richard Fink is a contributing writer in Los Angeles, California. Born in Phoenix, Arizona, Richard holds a Bachelor's Degree in Film and Media Production from ASU and has been writing professional about film and television since 2021. Movies have always been his passion, and he has a passion for history, comics, and cooking. Contact him at richardf@movieweb.com Daredevil: Born Again is returning to Disney+ for Season 2, a little over a year after Season 1 debuted. The Disney+ series is a continuation of Daredevil, which aired on Netflix from 2015 to 2018. In fact, Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 is arriving one week after the 10th anniversary of when Daredevil Season 2 debuted in 2016. The new season of the series will pick up in the immediate aftermath of Daredevil: Born Again Season 1. Mayor Wilson Fisk/ Kingpin has declared a war on vigilantes in New York City, and Matt Murdock/Daredevil is leading an underground resistance. The season will see the return of Krysten Ritter as Jessica Jones, and Matthew Lillard has joined the series as a mysterious new character. With anticipation high for Daredevil and Kingpin's war of crime, here is when Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 will premiere on Disney+, what time each new episode will air, and when the season will conclude. 'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Release Schedule Disney+ Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 will officially debut on Disney+ on Mar. 24, 2026, at 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m ET. Unlike Born Again Season 1, which had a two-episode premiere, Born Again Season 2 will debut with a single episode. However, the following week of Mar. 31, 2026, will see episodes two and three released together. Following that, new episodes will be released weekly, starting Tuesday at 6 p.m. PT/ 9 p.m. ET. The season will consist of eight episodes, which is one fewer than Season 1, and will conclude on May 5, 2026. The following week, The Marvel Special Presentation Punisher: One Last Kill, will be released on May 12, 2026. 'Daredevil Born Again' Season 2 Episode Title Release Date Episode 1 "The Northern Star" Mar. 24, 2026 Episode 2 "Shoot the Moon" Mar. 31, 2026 Episode 3 "The Scales & the Swords" Mar. 31, 2026 Episode 4 "Gloves Off" Apr. 7, 2026 Episode 5 "The Grand Design" Apr. 14, 2026 Episode 6 "Requiem" Apr. 21, 2026 Episode 7 "The Hateful Darkness" April 28, 2026 Episode 8 "The Southern Cross" May 5, 2026 The Punisher: One Last Kill May 12, 2026 Marvel 2026's Schedule and Beyond Disney+ Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 is the second entry in the MCU's 2026 slate, following Wonder Man's eight-episode release on Jan. 27, 2026. After Daredevil: Born Again Season 2, The Punisher Special Presentation will debut between it and the release of Spider-Man: Brand New Day on Jul. 31, 2026, where Jon Benrthal will also appear as The Punisher. Following Daredevil: Born Again Season 2, X-Men '97 Season 2 is expected to hit Disney+ sometime in Summer 2026. Your browser does not support the video tag. After Spider-Man: Brand New Day opens in theaters towards the end of the summer movie season, Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Season 2 is expected to air sometime in Fall 2026 on Disney+. The next live-action show after Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 is Vision Quest, which has an unspecified 2026 release date. Finally, at the end of the year, audiences will be able to see Avengers: Doomsday, which is set for release on Dec. 18, 2026. However, Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 ends, but it will not be the last. Season 3 of the series is already confirmed to debut in March 2027. Meanwhile, Krysten Ritter has teased more Jessica Jones, either in Born Again Season 3 or a revival of her own series. Interestingly, Daredevil: Born Again Season 3 is the only live-action MCU title confirmed for 2027 aside from Avengers: Secret Wars on Dec. 17, 2027, although we know that Wonder Man has been renewed for Season 2.
